fonts.heading: Outfit, sans-serif
fonts.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

typography.pairing_strategy: Modern SaaS Tech: Outfit provides a geometric, friendly yet professional structure for headings, while Manrope offers exceptional legibility for dense CRM data tables and client dashboards.

colors.gradient_usage: CRITICAL: Avoid muddy gradients by never blending #FF6A00 directly into #0A6BFF for large surfaces. If a brand gradient is needed (e.g. for text or a thin active border), use a tricolor approach: from-[#FF6A00] via-[#B2367F] to-[#0A6BFF] or use them independently (Orange for primary CTA actions like 'Pagar', Blue for structural buttons and links).

admin_dashboard.structure: Sidebar (Dark Blue #051C3F on desktop) + Topbar (White/Dark) + Gray/Off-white Main Content area.
admin_dashboard.sidebar: Fixed width on desktop (w-64), collapsible to icon-only. Must include unread badge (Orange) for 'Alertas'. Logo at the top.
admin_dashboard.tables: CRITICAL: Wrap all data tables in a div with `className='w-full overflow-x-auto rounded-md border'`. Add horizontal scrolling to prevent breaking layout on mobile. Columns should use whitespace-nowrap.

client_portal.structure: Modern Premium SaaS look. Floating Topbar or subtle Sidebar. Max-width container (`max-w-7xl mx-auto`) for the dashboard.
client_portal.line_cards: Glassmorphic or crisp soft-shadow cards. Must feature 'Consumption Progress Bars' mapping gigabytes/minutes. Use primary blue for the progress fill, accent orange for warnings (e.g. > 80% usage).
client_portal.spacing: Generous spacing. Use `gap-6` or `gap-8` for dashboard grids.

onboarding_wizard.structure: Split screen or centered massive card. Left side: Brand presence + dynamic abstract image/pattern. Right side: Multi-step form (Datos, Dirección, Pago, KYC, Confirmar).
onboarding_wizard.kyc: File upload zones must look interactive (dashed borders, hover states).
onboarding_wizard.e_signature: Canvas block for signature + explicit accept checkboxes.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for sticky client portal header: `bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border`.

components.StatCard: Must include title, numeric value, an icon (Lucide) in a rounded badge (bg-primary/10 text-primary), and an optional delta (+/- %) indicator.
components.ProgressBar: For consumption. `h-2 rounded-full bg-secondary overflow-hidden`. Inner div `bg-primary transition-all duration-500`.
components.AlertsFeed: Timeline layout with severity colors mapping to semaphores.
components.SidebarNav: Accordion or standard list. Active state: `bg-sidebar-accent text-sidebar-accent-foreground border-r-2 border-accent`.

motion.page_transitions: Framer motion `<motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3 }} />`
motion.progress_bars: Must animate from 0 to actual value on mount.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over brand blue and brand orange is white (`text-white`). Avoid orange text on white backgrounds unless it is bold and large.
accessibility.focus: All interactables must have `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:ring-offset-2`.
accessibility.data_testids: MANDATORY: Every button, input, row action, and navigation link must have a descriptive kebab-case `data-testid`.

media.logo_strategy: Use the provided URL. In the dark admin sidebar, ensure the image is cleanly rendered. In public headers, size appropriately (e.g., h-8 or h-10). Use in onboarding wizard header, client portal header, and email templates.
media.pdf_invoices: CRITICAL: Do not restyle existing PDF layouts.

logo.description: GoRoky Corporate Logo (Orange to Blue wordmark)
logo.usage: Global branding, Admin Sidebar header, Client Portal top bar, Onboarding Wizard, Login screen.

onboarding_background.description: Abstract modern connectivity blue and orange flowing lines
onboarding_background.usage: Use as a high-end visual background for the left pane in the public Onboarding Wizard/Login to establish a premium telecom vibe.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a hybrid full-stack application for a Spanish telecom distributor (Admin CRM + Client SaaS + Public Onboarding). All UI copy must be in Spanish.
IMPLEMENT THE THEME IN `.css` FILE EXACTLY AS PROVIDED IN `colors.theme_tokens`. Do not invent random colors. Map Recharts colors to the theme.
Data Tables are critical: Use Shadcn Table but YOU MUST wrap `<Table>` inside a `<div className='w-full overflow-x-auto rounded-md border'>` to prevent mobile view breakage.
Build a clear Client Portal layout distinct from the Admin CRM. Make it feel premium (use the defined line cards with progress bars for telecom consumption).

Never combine #FF6A00 and #0A6BFF into a linear gradient background. Keep them separate for functional meaning, or use the tricolor text-clip workaround if you need the brand gradient visually on text.
Implement Semantic Status Pills exactly matching the color mappings provided.
Include a 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, table rows) for robust E2E testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp soft shadows.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Do not center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Never apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`.
Use modern pill-shaped or rounded-md buttons with clear hover states.
Never use AI assistant emojis (🤖, 💡, 🔮) as icons. Use lucide-react exclusively.
Ensure every interaction has micro-animations. Static = dead.
Always check contrast and ensure accessibility standards.
